result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the church.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area with a marked continental crosswalk and a bike lane. While basic infrastructure is present, parked vehicles right up to the crossing significantly obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street at the foreground intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Visible Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which may lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized crossing, but safety is compromised by faded markings and sidewalk obstructions. Parked vehicles near the intersection and debris on the walkway create visibility and accessibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: Debris and trash bags are piled on the sidewalk, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left sidewalk near the utility pole

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to improve driver awareness and yielding.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.
